implementation_strategy: CPU-hosted orchestrator calls the hosted model API (openai_responses:gpt-5-mini). For each deterministic seed-controlled task the pipeline executes: (1) intent canonicalizer → canonical intent (deterministic, local CPU); (2) baseline agent: single initial generation call to gpt-5-mini returning candidate configuration; (3) staged-rollout simulator executes canary→progressive→full stages and logs outcomes; (4) guarded agent: single initial generation call plus at-most-one deterministic repair invocation via generate_validate_repair_v1 (contract bounds two total model calls per task). Deterministic automated scorer paired_binary_episode_v1 computes safe-deploy booleans. All artefacts (task seed, prompts, model responses, simulator logs, verifier outputs, hashes) are archived.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic seed-controlled generator (public script). Seeds 1..400 map to task indices 1..400; manifest archived with provenance hashes.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (intent→config canonicalizer + single-model generation). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (initial generation + deterministic verifier-invoked repair stage; simulator-driven staged-rollout semantics). All transformations deterministic and unit-tested in artifact repo.
randomisation_plan: No randomisation for confirmatory sample. Task generation is deterministic via public seed list; pairing is within-task (baseline vs guarded).
caching_plan: Cache all model responses and simulator/verifier outputs per task artifact to avoid re-issuing identical hosted API calls; cache used only for deterministic replay verification and artifact integrity checks.
failure_recovery_plan: No human intervention permitted. Per-adapter limits: do not retry model calls beyond maximum_attempts_per_call. If hosted-model API transient error occurs for a call, mark the agent-run as failed and apply missingness_plan (automated exclusion from primary analysis). If >20% of pairs flagged as excluded by deterministic infrastructure checks, run automated diagnostics and abort per preregistered stopping_rule. All failures logged with deterministic provenance and hashes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (per-pair record: task_index, seed, condition_outputs {baseline,guarded}: {model_response_hash, config, simulator_rollout_log_hash, verifier_log_hash, safe_deploy_boolean, time_to_rollback_seconds_if_any}, exclusion_flag, exclusion_reason). Full schema archived with artifacts.
estimated_compute_notes: Total model calls = maximum_model_calls = 800 (400 tasks × up to 2 hosted calls per task). Hosted API calls executed sequentially in 8 batches; CPU-bound simulator and verifier run on local CPU host. Expected wall-clock ≤ 3 days under hosted API rate limits; within manifest 7-day limit. Total archived artifact size estimated ≈ 2–5 GB (logs, hashes, prompts, responses).
